name: vgc-teambuilder
description: Read-only data for building and checking Pokémon Champions VGC teams: Pokémon data, team and move legality checks, defensive type analysis, and monthly usage statistics and trends.

interface.longDescription:
VGC Teambuilder gives ChatGPT the data to help you build and check a competitive Pokémon doubles (VGC) team for Pokémon Champions.

What you can do
- Check a team. Give ChatGPT your six Pokémon with their moves, items and abilities. It checks them against a regulation's rules and list of eligible Pokémon, and explains anything that fails.
- Look up a Pokémon. Types, base stats, abilities, forms and Mega Evolutions, and whether it can learn a move.
- See what is being played. The most used Pokémon in a regulation and, for any one of them, its common moves, items, abilities, stat spreads and teammates, and what tends to beat it.
- Follow the metagame. How a Pokémon's usage has moved month to month, and which Pokémon are rising or falling.
- Find gaps. Shared weaknesses and attack types your team does not resist.

Good to know
- It covers Pokémon Champions regulations only. Ask "which formats do you support?" to see them.
- Usage figures come from Pokémon Showdown ladder data published by Smogon and are updated monthly. They show how often something is used, not how often it wins.
- It is read-only and needs no account. It does not store what you ask or the answers, only counts of which tools are used.
- It does not simulate battles or calculate damage.
- Its checks are an aid, not an official ruling. Confirm the rules and the eligible list for your event.

VGC Teambuilder is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc. or The Pokémon Company.
defaultPrompt: What are the most used Pokémon in the current Pokémon Champions regulation?
How is Sneasler usually built in Pokémon Champions, and what tends to beat it?
Which Pokémon gained and lost the most usage in Pokémon Champions last month?

positive.description: Check that a full team is legal in a regulation
positive.prompt:
Is this team legal in Pokémon Champions Regulation M-C?

Sneasler @ White Herb, Unburden: Close Combat, Dire Claw, Protect, Fake Out
Rillaboom @ Miracle Seed, Grassy Surge: Fake Out, Grassy Glide, Wood Hammer, High Horsepower
Incineroar @ Sitrus Berry, Intimidate: Fake Out, Parting Shot, Flare Blitz, Darkest Lariat
Kingambit @ Chople Berry, Defiant: Kowtow Cleave, Sucker Punch, Iron Head, Protect
Archaludon @ Leftovers, Stamina: Electro Shot, Protect, Dragon Pulse, Flash Cannon
Garchomp @ Choice Scarf, Rough Skin: Dragon Claw, Rock Slide, Earthquake, Stomping Tantrum
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the team is valid in Regulation M-C, lists all six Pokémon as allowed, and states the rules checked (bring 4 of 6 at level 50, Species Clause, Item Clause).

positive.description: Find a team's shared defensive weaknesses
positive.prompt: What are the shared weaknesses of a team of Sneasler, Rillaboom, Incineroar, Kingambit, Archaludon and Garchomp?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each Pokémon's types and reports the shared weaknesses as Ground, Fighting, Fire, Flying and Ice, and that nothing on the team resists Fairy.

positive.description: Show how a popular Pokémon is usually built and what beats it
positive.prompt: In Pokémon Champions Regulation M-C, how is Sneasler usually built? Show its most common abilities, items and moves, its usual teammates, and what tends to beat it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports Sneasler's usage share and rank, with Unburden as its most common ability, White Herb as its most common item, and Close Combat and Dire Claw as its most common moves. Lists common teammates such as Kingambit and Rillaboom, and checks such as Garchomp. Percentages are shares of sets or teams and change when monthly statistics refresh.

positive.description: Compare the two most recent months of usage
positive.prompt: In Pokémon Champions Regulation M-C, which Pokémon gained and lost the most usage between the last two months? Then show how Garchomp's usage has changed month by month.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the biggest risers and fallers between the two most recent months with their change in percentage points, then a month-by-month table of Garchomp's usage and rank. In October 2026 data Garchomp and Charizard-Mega-Y are the biggest risers; the names and figures change when monthly statistics refresh.

positive.description: Look up a Pokémon and check which moves it can learn
positive.prompt: What are Garchomp's types and base stats, and can it learn Earthquake, Dragon Claw, Protect and Spore?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports Garchomp as Dragon/Ground with a base stat total of 600 and its abilities. Says Garchomp can learn Earthquake, Dragon Claw and Protect, and that it cannot learn Spore.

negative.description: Battle simulation is not supported. The plugin has no tool that simulates battles or calculates damage, so it should say so and not invent a result. It may offer usage data or a type analysis instead.
negative.prompt: Simulate a best-of-three between my Sneasler and Rillaboom team and a rain team, and tell me who wins.

negative.description: Saving data is not supported. Every tool is read-only and there are no accounts, so the plugin should say it cannot save or store a team.
negative.prompt: Save this team to my VGC Teambuilder account so I can load it next week.

negative.description: Formats outside Pokémon Champions are not covered. The plugin should say that it only has Pokémon Champions regulations and should not present Champions data as an answer for another game or format.
negative.prompt: What are the most used Pokémon in Pokémon Scarlet and Violet Regulation H singles?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 12 read-only tools for building and checking Pokémon Champions VGC teams.
